name: Burgruine Ehrenberg
kurzbeschreibung: One of the largest fortress complexes in Central Europe near Reutte, with an adventure museum, inclined lifts and the highline179 suspension bridge, which is over 400 m long.
beschreibung:
The Burgenwelt Ehrenberg is located on the historic Via Claudia Augusta south of Reutte and is one of the most important fortress complexes in Central Europe. It combines four sites: the Ehrenberger Klause, the Ehrenberg castle ruins, the Schlosskopf fortress and Fort Claudia. In the adventure museum "Dem Ritter auf der Spur" ("On the Trail of the Knight"), 14 themed rooms tell the story of the complex.

The highlight is the highline179 suspension bridge, over 400 metres long, spanning the valley. Two inclined lifts, the Ehrenberg Liner and the Top Liner, make the fortress complex accessible without barriers. An inn with a hotel, the Café Klause, a museum and dairy shop, as well as playgrounds round off the offer. Open daily: in summer from 9 am to 6 pm, in winter from 10 am to 4 pm.
